notes.title: Patch Notes April 13, 2022
notes.content:
-Updated the tutorial to better explain the mechanics
-Made the Desert level easier
-Increased the hitbox size of orbs
-Added a gradient to the charge FX
-Adjusted the placement of a shortcut
-Added a new title screen effect

tags.feature: -Added a gradient to the charge FX

notes.title: Patch Notes April 4, 2022
notes.content:
Fixed bugs with sound effects playing when they're not supposed to.
Stopped Autocharge mode from spawning particles while holding S.
Raised the number of Jumps and Falls to unlock their respective achievements.
